detection_samples.description: Detects brute force or credential stuffing against OCI Console by counting failed login attempts per user. Uses frequency analysis (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Sorting/Stacking method) to identify accounts with more than 3 failed attempts in the time window.

native_alarm.title: OCI Console Brute Force
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: OCI Console Brute Force is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Detects users making a high volume of IAM changes in a short time window. A burst of identity changes (policy updates, user creation, group modifications) from a single principal may indicate account compromise or insider threat. Uses frequency analysis with threshold (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Forecasting/Anomaly Detection method).

native_alarm.title: IAM Rapid Configuration Changes
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: IAM Rapid Configuration Changes is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Detects potential privilege escalation by identifying users who perform a sequence of IAM operations: creating policies, groups, or dynamic groups followed by adding themselves to privileged groups. Combines multiple identity control plane events from the same principal to surface escalation chains.

native_alarm.title: OCI Privilege Escalation Chain
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: OCI Privilege Escalation Chain is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Identifies principals performing an abnormally high number of destructive operations (delete, terminate). A spike in resource destruction from a single user may indicate a compromised account performing sabotage, ransomware-style destruction, or an insider threat. Uses threshold-based anomaly detection (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Forecasting/Anomaly Detection method).

native_alarm.title: OCI Resource Destruction Spike
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: OCI Resource Destruction Spike is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Detects code-of-conduct themed AiTM/token-replay behavior by following one principal through login, discovery, Object Storage access, and auth-token creation.

native_alarm.title: Cloud Identity Token Abuse
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: Cloud Identity Token Abuse is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Calculates a threat score per source IP based on the diversity of attack types (SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, command injection, SSRF). An IP triggering multiple different CRS rule categories indicates a sophisticated attacker using multiple techniques. Uses combined scoring (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Combined Methods).

native_alarm.title: WAF Multi-Attack Vector Scoring
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: WAF Multi-Attack Vector Scoring is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Identifies source IPs generating the most WAF block events. Uses frequency analysis (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Sorting/Stacking) to surface prolific attackers targeting the web application. IPs with high block counts indicate automated attack tools.

native_alarm.title: WAF Attack Frequency by Source
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: WAF Attack Frequency by Source is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Identifies IPs performing brute force attacks against web login endpoints by counting 401/403 responses. Uses frequency analysis (Threat Hunter's Cookbook: Sorting/Stacking) to surface credential stuffing and brute force campaigns.

native_alarm.title: Web Application Brute Force
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: Web Application Brute Force is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Counts C2 and exfiltration flow evidence observed by VCN Flow Logs and Network Firewall logs for the known external destination.

native_alarm.title: C2 Flow Connections
native_alarm.body: OCI Log Analytics detection metric crossed its configured threshold.

alarmMetaData.alarmSummary: C2 Flow Connections is in a FIRING state.

detection_samples.description: Summarizes the web-to-cloud attack chain across WAF, load balancer, application, host, VCN Flow, Network Firewall, Sysmon network, and OCI Audit logs. The shared Trace ID and fixed attacker/C2 pivots let analysts follow entry point, credential access, C2, cloud abuse, and exfiltration in one widget.
